Chapter 521 - 521 Decision; Execution!

Chapter 521 - 521 Decision; Execution!

521 Decision; Execution!

Bear Country.

“Wuka City isn’t even in an earthquake zone. No earthquakes will happen, let alone a magnitude 9.1 earthquake!”

“9.1 magnitude earthquake? Is this a joke?”

“There are times when machines fail. We don’t have to pay too much attention to it.”

“9.1 magnitude earthquake? Wouldn’t that mean that all of the ten million people in Wuka City would have to move away? How much trouble would that bring? He must be joking!”

“We can’t move!”

“We should send an earthquake expert to Wuka City to do some research!”

“That’s right!”

…

At this moment, the man with a buzz cut who had been sitting in the main seat and had not spoken all this while finally opened his mouth. “Quiet down.”

His voice was not loud.

However, the entire meeting room immediately fell silent.

Obviously, he had great prestige!

The man continued, “Five days. What if a 9.1 magnitude earthquake really happens in five days? Who will be responsible?”

Everyone in the meeting room opened their mouths, but no one could say anything.

Who would be responsible?

Who dared to take responsibility?

After all, this matter was too big.

If it was true, how big of a disaster would it be?

Even if they died, they would not be able to bear the consequences.

They would become a sinner, a sinner who would be cursed by countless people!

“Pass down the message,” the man with the buzz cut said. “Make sure that Wuka City is completely evacuated within five days at all costs. Also, make preparations to evacuate Hasi City, Mariku City, and Dengsha City, which are closer to Wuka City!”

Not only did they have to evacuate Wuka City, but they also had to evacuate the other three cities.

In one breath, they had to evacuate four cities!

This definitely took great courage!

“Yes!” Everyone’s hearts turned solemn as they replied in unison.

…

It had to be said that Bear Country’s execution was not bad.

Soon, a large number of people arrived at Wuka City.

When some people who did not pay attention to the internet heard that an earthquake was about to happen, they were completely at a loss.

There were also many people who, like those on the internet, expressed their disbelief that a magnitude 9.1 earthquake would occur and refused to leave.

There were also some people who were unwilling to leave their homes.

These were undoubtedly a hindrance to the operation.

However, what Bear Country was best at was overcoming obstacles.

They did not care if the residents were at a loss, or if they did not believe them, or if they were unwilling to leave…

The officers stuffed everyone into buses, trucks, planes, and other means of transportation before transporting them out of Wuka City.

These things were filmed by some people and posted online.

Mi Sifang: [The first day in Wuka City upon receiving the news.

[In the past, I never believed that the Easterners knew magic, but today, I believe it.

[The Easterners said that Wuka City is about to experience a 9.1 magnitude earthquake.

[Our Bear Country believed it.

[The pursuit of justice while disregarding scientific theories and violently destroying beautiful families one after another…

[Cries and shouts ripple on the streets.

[My friend told me that some of those who refused even died in accidents.

[Their corpses could even fill up several houses!

[Photo.jpg, photo.jpg…

[Bear Country, please wake up!]

Some people quickly had an idea after seeing the post and carried out intentional publicity.

Not long after, this post actually appeared in the headlines of major news around the world.

This immediately caused countless people to discuss it.

When Mi Sifang saw this, he was so happy that he could not control himself.

Therefore, he wrote more posts

….

Bear Country did not care about any of this.

This was because they had already put all their energy into moving the residents of Wuka City, Hasi City, Mariku City, Dengsha City, and other cities.

…

Bear Country was not bothered about it, and Lin Fan did not even think about it.

As usual, he drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu and Nie Zhenjiang were discussing intensely.

“Will there really be a 9.1 magnitude earthquake in Bear Country’s Wuka City?” Nie Zhenjiang was a little confused.

“Whether it happens or not, the earthquake prediction device is an amazing invention. It has brought a leap forward in earthquake physics!” Liu Qianqian said with certainty.

She was a physics major and had some knowledge of earthquake physics. She had read Lin Fan’s thesis.

Liu Qianqian knew very well how useful earthquake predictors were for earthquake physics.

“The earthquake prediction device has encountered a big issue this time. If it’s wrong, I’m afraid it’ll have some impact on Professor Lin.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue, who had always been quiet and did not like to talk, raised their heads and said in a very firm tone, “Professor Lin won’t be wrong!”

Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and Jiang Chaoqun could not help but focus their attention on Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue met the gazes of the four people and were still extremely determined.

At this moment, there was the sound of brisk footsteps outside.

A tall and handsome figure slowly walked in.

It was Lin Fan!

Xia Bing and Xia Xue immediately gave up on their firm gazes. They picked up the energy drinks and shyly handed them to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan opened them and drank a mouthful of each.

“Meow!”

Then, Lil White, who was lying on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder, let out a loud cry.

“Master, can you give me something delicious to eat?”

Lil White came to Lin Fan’s feet and rubbed against him.

Lin Fan stroked it gently. Then, he tore open the premium beef cat food and poured it in front of it.

Everything was as calm and ordinary as usual.

It was as if Lin Fan did not know the results of the earthquake prediction device and had not seen the news.

“Professor Lin, have you seen the news?” Hao Zhiwu asked. “The Earthquake Center seemed to have predicted that there’ll be a 9.1 magnitude earthquake in Bear Country’s Wuka City.

“But Wuka City doesn’t seem to be in the earthquake zone. Is this a wrong prediction?”

Lin Fan patted the cat’s head a few more times before saying, “The earthquake prediction device can’t be wrong.”

“Really? Then…” Hao Zhiwu opened his mouth, wanting to say something.

Lin Fan did not plan to wait for him to finish his words. He said, “Didn’t you say you wanted to study the nervous system? Have you written the thesis?”

Hao Zhiwu coughed lightly and said, “Not yet.”

Then, he turned on the computer and started typing on the keyboard.

…

Five days passed in a flash.

There was no one left in the vast city of Wuka City.

However, the eyes of everyone in the world were focused on it.
